title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (6/20): Reading the Western Chamber Together
note_en: Watch 到 after verbs in this episode: 把它带到桃花树下 "took it to the peach tree," 正唱到 "had just reached (these lines in the song)," 黛玉听到的那几句 "the lines Daiyu heard." After a verb, 到 shows that the action reached its goal or result. 听 alone is "listen"; 听到 means the sound actually reached you, the way English "listen" becomes "hear."
